- Tutorial is now available before player start from first stage (Fire Floor)

- Fire Guardian Skill Switch Fixes
- Key Input Invert fixes 
- Key Input now is Fully Fixes !

notes.title: Golem Patch (0.0.2)
notes.content:
[b] BUG FIXES[/b]
- Prologue Character Location Bug Fixes

[b]NEW FEATURE[/b]
- Keybinding Options now has been Available , this feature let user to binding the key actions between these listed actions below :
1. Jump
2. Right Movement
3. Left Movement
4. Basic Shot 
5. Skill 

this binding operation can be done through the Tittle Screen of the Game by clicking the configuration button, and assign the key by pressing the button in the field you want to change .

There will be another actions updated following our new content that we will push in the next update.
Thanks Player !

notes.title: Marionette Patch 2.0.0
notes.content:
[b]MAJOR UPDATES MARIONETTE PATCH 2.0.0[/b]

[b]BUG FIXES[/b]

- Some character animation has been fixes
- Some bug Fixes on the Dialogue 
- Loot Fixes


[b]FEATURE UPDATE[/b]

- Now character stat can be upgraded via Granny Shack Merchant - These include :
 1. MAX HP 
 2. MAX MP
 3. STRENGTH
 4. DEFENSE

- To Upgrade the basic stat of the character - need Medallion Exchange to get AP (Ability Point) - all of these Medallion will drop in all enemies on every dungeon for certain percentage - These Medallion Includes :
        1. Medallion of Sorrow 
        2. Medallion of Courage 
        3. Medallion of Wisdom 
        4. Medallion of Knowledge

- Now you can buy Potion and Mana Potion in Granny Shack as your Primary items on the game


Thanks in Advance for joining Our Early Access version - Stay tune for our next updates !
